_comment: Single source of truth for car dimensions. Read by crates/gtlinks-sim (include_str!), by the Blender build scripts, and copied into the web bundle. Metres and kilograms. Body frame: +Z forward, +Y up, +X left; origin on the ground, centred between the axles. Wheel centres: x = +/- track/2, y = wheel_radius, z = +/- wheelbase/2. Order FL, FR, RL, RR. Names are parodies; no real marque names, badges or logos anywhere in the project.

cars.name: Cadillax Escapade (2009)
cars.character: Heavy, soft and tall. Holds its lager badly and rolls easily.

cars.name: Mercy-Bends GLUG (2017)
cars.character: Big and composed until the ninth stein. Then it is neither.

cars.name: Genesips GV-Ale (2021)
cars.character: Balanced. The sensible choice, relatively speaking.

cars.name: Range Roller (2026)
cars.character: Long suspension travel. Best off the fairway, and named for how it finishes.
